mentions.name: Otto Harness
mentions.description: An agent harness for running agent tasks, similar to Airflow, currently in alpha. Each run executes in a container with a single network bridge carrying all tool calls and model communication, and each run gets a capability token whose grants the host checks for attempted tool calls. The core is thin, with credentials handling and model communication provided as packages. Example jobs trigger on a Slack alert channel and debug alerts using GitHub, kube, and a work MCP, dropping a comment on every alert with the cause. Still closed source, with plans to change that after more testing.
mentions.problem: Existing agent tools like OpenClaw are too insecure to use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An agent harness that is kind of like airflow for agent tasks.

I thought open claw was cool but could never use something so insecure.

Each run is in a container. One network bridge out so everything from tool calls to model communication goes over the bridge.
